why: First dialogue occurrence of this common noun (rows 3316, 3332, 3333: an unnamed Neo Zeon Jagd Doga pilot using funnels, sensed by Amuro Ray). The project already describes this exact archetype as 'Cyber Newtype' for Gyunei Guss in character_names_021.json ('Neo Zeon Cyber Newtype mobile suit pilot'), so the dialogue term was matched to that existing description rather than translated literally as 'Enhanced Human', to keep later batches consistent.
